reviewContext.userProblem: Key parts of the nodetto specification (fractional keys, z-order, NMESH codec, TSV round trip, anchored rotation, undo/redo history, three-way merge, overlap search) are only tested, not proved. The user wants a Lean 4 project in formal/ that models these algorithms, states the specified invariants as theorems, proves them with no gaps, ties each model to the real TypeScript through Lean-generated test vectors, and fixes every counterexample in code or design text.
requiredOutcomes: mise run prove exits 0 on a clean checkout with the mise toolchain: every module builds, the audit finds no sorry/admit/axiom/native_decide and only propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound, and regenerated vectors equal the committed ones.

Every theorem named in design-docs/specs/design-formal-verification.md section 6 (66 required, 3 open) exists in formal/ with exactly the stated signature, or the design records the counterexample and the corrected statement; open statements that are not proved are listed under '## Open' in docs/formal.md.
For each of the eight modules a bun test next to the TypeScript source checks the real implementation against formal/vectors/<module>.json and passes.

Findings D1-D7 are resolved as decided in design section 5: D2 (merge canonicalJson and own-member semantics), D3 (z-order duplicate ids refused), D6 (fractional NaN rng) and D7 (fractional no-room descent made iterative, no stack overflow on long valid keys) fixed in code with regression tests; D1 (TSV zero-field rows) and D4 (rotation lattice) fixed in design text; D5 intended. All are listed in docs/formal.md.
Existing tests are unaffected: mise run verify and mise run test-cli pass; bun run typecheck and biome pass (integration step).
docs/formal.md lists what is proved, under which assumptions (B1-B8), and what is not proved; README mentions formal/.
nonGoals: No Mathlib, Batteries or other Lake dependency; core Lean and its Std only.
No proof about floating point; integer bridging assumptions B1-B8 are stated instead.
No Rust models in this delivery.
prove is not added to verify, test, ci or .github/workflows/linux.yml.
Schematic-mode modules (design section 11) are not implemented.
No change to packages/core/src/index.ts, no new npm dependency, no THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md change.
No push, rebase, merge, worktree or branch; no server, auth, secret or deployment code.
constraints: Plans edit only their writePaths; writePaths are disjoint except each module root formal/Nodetto/<M>.lean, created by the module's model plan and given one import line per proof plan, with those plans chained by dependsOn. formal/Nodetto.lean, mise.toml, README.md and docs/formal.md belong only to fv-50-docs.

Lean runs only as `cd formal && mise exec -- lake build <own target>` or `mise exec -- lake exe <exe>` (and formal/scripts/audit). Never lake clean; retry a build-lock failure up to three times and log it.

Proof integrity: no sorry, admit, axiom, native_decide, unsafe, partial, opaque, implemented_by, extern, skipKernelTC or #exit in formal/**/*.lean, no maxHeartbeats above 400000, decide only on small literals. Theorems copy the design section 6 statements verbatim; no added hypothesis, narrowed type or changed conclusion.

Counterexample procedure: a false required statement stops the plan with a Lean example and the matching TypeScript input/output in the progress log (needs_design_revision); the worker never alters the statement or TS code on its own.
Models are total, executable, mirror the TS structure and name the source path and function in a doc comment; models import only other model files.
Workers read fresh before each edit and record git hash-object before and after in their own progress log impl-plans/progress/<planId>.md; no git state changes, lockfile changes or broad formatters.

At most two bun test or cargo test processes at a time across branches; the orchestrator serializes wave-4 conformance bun tests. Timing tests that fail under load but pass alone count as passing with both logs recorded.

Per-plan gates never include workspace-wide bun run typecheck or mise run verify; those run once at integration. Strict TypeScript compatible with noUncheckedIndexedAccess; biome must pass on touched files.
Evidence lives under tmp/fv-s942/<planId>/ only; no *.test.ts files under tmp/ or target/ after a plan finishes.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: D1: the TSV round trip parseTsv(serializeTsv(grid)) = grid is stated for grids whose rows each have at least one field; the three zero-field counterexamples are proved as theorems and delimited.ts is unchanged.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Confirmed at runtime by a Bun probe; a zero-field row has no TSV spelling distinct from a one-empty-field row or the final newline, and clipboardGrid never produces one for a valid table.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: D2: merge equality uses a new canonicalJson with own-member semantics (Object.hasOwn reads, Object.defineProperty writes); canonicalValue is removed; mergeValue and mergeById are exported.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: JSON.stringify comparison is key-order sensitive and loses the only real change in the reordered-object example; canonicalValue drops own __proto__ members created by JSON.parse.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: D3: reorderCommands also refuses an order with a duplicate id.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: A duplicate id of the right length emits two reorders for one element and leaves another untouched, contradicting the documented contract.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: D4: rotation identities carry the lattice hypothesis; rotate_anchor_snapped states the general behaviour; design-breadboard.md 4.2 is clarified.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Clockwise then counter-clockwise is the identity only when pin 1 is on the lattice; otherwise the first turn snaps the anchor.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: D5: reorderCommands_spec has the hypothesis that the target differs from the current order; reorderCommands_unchanged covers the other case.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: The sameOrder early return is intended: nothing is emitted when nothing has to move.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: D6: randomDigitBetween maps a NaN offset to 0.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Rng is typed () => number, and NaN made keyBetween return undefined; with the fix every reachable offset maps to a Lean draw (B2), so keyBetween_between covers every rng.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: Strings are modelled as List Nat code units (fractional, NMESH armour, TSV) or as the fixed-width hex encoding E (ids, merge keys and values).
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: E is injective on JavaScript strings including lone surrogates, which Lean Char cannot hold, and keeps code-unit order.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: Vectors are integer-only; non-integer quantities are emitted pre-scaled (Rotate localBox2/pinDefs2 hold twice the pitch values).
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Json.Value.num is Int, keeping vectors exact and inside the bridging assumptions.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: Conformance gates build Nodetto.<M>.Model rather than the module root.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: The root may be mid-edit by a concurrent proof plan of the same module; root builds and theorem checks run in the proof plans and in mise run prove.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: Open statements decodeNmesh_encodeNmesh, treeSearch_visits_overlaps and overlappingPairs_visits_overlaps may stay open.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Targeted if feasible per the request; fv-50 lists unproved ones under '## Open' and the full audit enforces it.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: D7: midpoint runs the upper-null no-room descent iteratively; outputs and rng consumption are unchanged and no key-length limit is added (fv-40).
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: keyBetween("y" + "z".repeat(32768), "z", () => 0) and keyAfter("z".repeat(32768), () => 0) throw RangeError (maximum call stack size exceeded) on valid keys before the change, as the plan reviewer reproduced with bun -e.

intentionalTradeoffs: TSV zero-field rows keep their lossy serialization; only the design text and characterization tests change.
The live mergeValue and the CLI mergeDocumentVersions routines are fixed separately and not unified (design 6.7 proof boundary); only the live routines are proved.
Conformance gates build only the model module, so a root-level break is caught by the proof plans and the final prove run rather than the conformance plan.
Concurrent lake builds share formal/.lake, mitigated by the three-retry rule.
supportedEdgeCases: Fractional keys with absent bounds, foreign (non-fractional) bounds, inverted or invalid bounds, and NaN or infinite rng values.
Z-order with everything selected, nothing to move, duplicate-id orders and tied foreign keys.
NMESH overlong and truncated varints, zigzag extremes, first-use index coding and base64 armour round trips.
TSV grids with trailing, only and inner zero-field rows and the [[""]] round trip.
Rotation with anchors on and off the lattice, all four quarter turns.
Undo batches, abortBatch, empty batches and create/delete/update on a finite-map store including presence failures.
Merge key-order-only differences, own __proto__ members, lone surrogate keys and both-sides-changed conflicts.
Overlap closed-box touching boxes on the integer grid for the sweep branch, with tree-branch cases covered by vectors.
outOfScopeEdgeCases: Floating-point values outside the stated integer domains (B3-B6).
mergeDocumentVersions (CLI merge) and the both-added page example are not proved.
Element validation, references, cascades and pages in the undo store (B8).
Schematic-mode connectivity, coordinate keys, net naming and segment sweep (future modules).
